up: Return all activity values and compound structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL3436043. Include the ChEMBL ID of the compound, the standard activity value, the standard units, the standard relation, the standard type, and the canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3436043';
